page.pickBody: Pick a conversation on the left, or start a new one. Chat is for day-to-day talk – decisions and findings still belong on the record itself.
page.notFoundBody: It may have been removed, or you are no longer a member.

connection.reconnecting: Reconnecting… new messages may arrive a little late.
connection.offline: You are offline. Messages can’t be sent until you are back online.

empty.title: No conversations yet
empty.body: Start a direct message with a colleague, create a group for a task, or find the channel for your team.

header.archivedBanner: This conversation is archived. You can read it, but not post.
header.readOnly: You can no longer post in this conversation.
header.joinHint: You are reading this channel. Join to post and get notified.

messages.beginning: This is the start of the conversation.
messages.emptyBody: Write the first message below. Type @ to mention someone, # to add a topic tag, and use “Link record” to point to a deviation, risk or document.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete message?
deleteConfirm.body: The message is removed for everyone in the conversation, together with its files.

deleteErrors.generic: The message could not be deleted.

attachments.blockedHint: This file was stopped by the virus check and can’t be opened.

record.noAccess: You don’t have access to this record

composer.label: Message to {{name}}
composer.sendHint: Enter sends · Shift+Enter adds a line
composer.tooLong: The message is too long ({{count}} of {{max}} characters).
composer.tooManyFiles: You can attach up to {{max}} files.
composer.tooManyLinks: You can link up to {{max}} records.

warnings.mentionNotMember: {{names}} can’t see this conversation and was not notified.

errors.generic: The message could not be sent.
errors.network: No connection. Try again when you are back online.
errors.conversation_read_only: You can no longer post in this conversation.
errors.empty_message: Write something or attach a file.
errors.entity_link_no_access: You don’t have access to one of the linked records.
errors.unsupported_entity_type: One of the linked records can’t be linked.
errors.invalid_mentions: One of the mentioned people is not in the organisation.
errors.invalid_attachments: One of the files can’t be attached. Remove it and try again.
errors.rate_limited: You are sending a lot right now. Wait a moment and try again.

picker.title: Link a record
picker.hint: Only records you can open are shown. People in the conversation who can’t open a record just see that it is hidden.
picker.start: Type to search deviations, risks, documents and more.

create.title: New conversation
create.dmHint: Choose one person to write to.
create.groupHint: Add up to 49 people. Good for a task or a small team.
create.channelHint: Channels are for a topic or a team. Public channels can be found and joined by everyone.
create.name: Name

visibility.label: Who can find it
visibility.public: Public – anyone in the organisation can find and join it
visibility.private: Private – only people who are added

create.subject: About

errors.generic: The conversation could not be created.
errors.name_taken: A channel with this name already exists.
errors.invalid_members: One of the people can’t use chat.
errors.member_no_record_access: Some of the people can’t open this record and can’t be added.
errors.rate_limited: You have created many conversations. Try again later.

members.title: Members
members.departmentNote: Members follow the department. Change who is in it under Settings → Departments.

removeConfirm.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeConfirm.body: {{name}} will no longer see new messages in this conversation.

leaveConfirm.title: Leave the conversation?
leaveConfirm.body: You will stop receiving its messages. You can be added again later.

archiveConfirm.title: Archive the conversation?
archiveConfirm.body: Members can still read it, but nobody can post. You can restore it later.

errors.generic: The change could not be saved.
errors.last_owner: There must be at least one owner.
errors.department_channel: Team channel members follow the department.
errors.member_no_record_access: That person can’t open the record this conversation is about.

search.label: Search messages
search.noneBody: Try other words or remove a filter.

empty.title: No channels to join
empty.body: You are already in every public channel, or none exist yet. Create one with “New conversation”.

discuss.title: Discussions about {{title}}
discuss.intro: Talk with colleagues about this record. Everyone you add must be able to open it.
discuss.noAccess: You can’t open discussions for this record.

admin.title: Chat
admin.intro: Retention, legal hold and data requests for chat. Here you see conversation details, never message content.

retention.title: Keep messages
retention.hint: Messages older than this are deleted every night. Conversations on legal hold are kept.

people.title: Data requests for one person
people.hint: Export or delete everything a person has written in chat (GDPR).

eraseConfirm.title: Delete all messages from {{name}}?
eraseConfirm.body: Everything {{name}} has written in chat in this organisation is deleted for everyone, with files and reactions. This can’t be undone.

orgExport.title: Export all chat
orgExport.hint: Downloads every message in the period as a file (at most 366 days).
orgExport.invalid: Choose a period of at most 366 days.
